latest_cos_commentary.headline: eCard Systems is a PE-backed (Housatonic Partners), POS-agnostic outsourced gift-card and loyalty processing provider integrated with 125+ POS platforms, including an official partnership supplying physical gift cards for Toast.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes with Genius's loyalty_engagement line at multi-location restaurant accounts by offering gift-card and loyalty processing that plugs into a wide range of third-party POS systems rather than requiring a single-vendor stack.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Received a growth PE investment in December 2023 aimed at expanding sales, marketing, technology, and production; no more recent funding or ownership events were found in this pass.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: If a prospect already runs a separate gift-card/loyalty processor across multiple POS brands, ask whether it is eCard Systems - relevant because it is POS-agnostic and could persist even through a POS switch.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Investment terms are undisclosed; brand/merchant-count figures come from two different sources measuring different things and are not independently reconciled.

verification_needed: current brand/merchant count as of 2026 (available figures are from 2023-2024 sources)
